**It's ~1082 occurrences across 94 files, in five services (orders, notify, billing, analytics, accounts) plus repos, services, and HTTP routes.**

Three places must keep `account_id` exactly as-is:

| Location | Why |
|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` and `WIRE` map in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | public API field, frozen by contract, clients read it by name |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/**` | third-party vendored SDK, not yours to rename |
| All files under `migrations/` (e.g. `20250114_create_accounts.sql`) | already applied in production, editing breaks the down-step and doesn't rename a live column |

So the real, safe scope is the internal repo/service/http layers across the five services. `lib/audit.js` also keys audit lines on `account_id` — check with the platform team whether that's an internal detail or an external log contract before touching it.

Net: sign off on renaming the internal usages, but block renaming the OpenAPI contract, the vendor SDK, and the SQL migration history.
